messages:
deploy-bot: 🚦 kicked off staged rollout: service=redwood-api version=v8.3.0 target=15% region=ap-south change_window=02:00-06:00 UTC details=https://deploys.internal/rollout/5019876543
kate: FYI QA saw a tiny BLEU delta on sampled prompts (0.08) but product OK'd it.
ryan: telemetry alert: ap-south error rate 5xx increased from 0.2% -> 1.5% within 2m of rollout. p50/p95 fine, tail looks off.
nina: infra reports container exits on node set a2-*, exit code 137 (OOM). attaching logs in a sec.
infra-oncall: logs: `killed process java (heap)`, repeated on three pods. not system OOM, looks like app-level oom in reranker thread.
ben: can we pin region back to v8.2.5 while triage? prefer not to global rollback if isolated.
chao: quick check: image hash differs from canary-candidate by one layer (quant-opt tweaks). maybe packaging mismatch.
kate: suggestion: hold rollout and replace image in cluster with the vetted canary build (reimage), test 1% smoke, then resume to 15% if stable. votes?
ryan: +1 to hold and reimage. avoids customer-visible revert.
nina: +1. reimage script ready: `infractl reimage --service redwood-api --region ap-south --image=hash-abc123`
infra-oncall: initiating reimage on two affected ASGs now, will report when back to Ready.
deploy-bot: rollout paused at 15% by @kate. traffic frozen to new version.
chao: running quick regression eval against release-checkset: before=91.2, after=91.1 (within noise). embedding L2 diff small.
ben: thresholds: if pod restarts >4 in 10m OR 5xx >1% sustained for 3m -> execute rollback to v8.2.5 with command:
```
rbctl rollback --service redwood-api --version v8.2.5 --scope region --region ap-south --reason "canary image mismatch / oom spikes"
```
infra-oncall: reimage done on 2 pods, both Ready. restarting smoke traffic at 1%. monitoring.
ryan: initial smoke: 5xx back to 0.2%, p99 latency unchanged. good sign.
kate: ok to proceed to 15% in 10m if no regressions. keep pin plan ready.
chao: leaving profiler capture on for 30m and will post link.
deploy-bot: note: change window ends 06:00 UTC. if rollback happens after window end, add `--post-window` flag.
ben: will prepare rollback notes and customer comms just in case.
kate: thanks. update here in 8m or sooner if thresholds hit. keep messages short. ✔️
